question: Who among the following was the recruiter, caretaker and commander of the Rani of Jhansi Regiment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshmi Swaminathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Janaky Athi Nahappan and Lakshmi Swaminathan were commanders of the Rani of Jhansi Regiment.__

 
• The Rani of Jhansi Regiment was the women's regiment of the Indian National Army. It was formed on 12 July, 1943 by Subhash Chandra Bose.
 
• It was formed by Indian nationalists with the intention of overthrowing the British rule in India with the help of Japan.
 
• Most of the ladies were teenage volunteers of Indian descent from Malayan rubber estates; only a few had ever been to India.
 
• Its training camp was set up in Singapore with 170 cadets.
 
• By November 1943, camps were established in Burma(Myanmar) and Bangkok, Thailand, and volunteers had increased to 300.
 
• The cadets underwent military and combat training with drills, route marches in addition to weapons training in rifles, hand grenades, and bayonet charges.
 
• Its first passing out parade was held in Singapore on 30 March 1944.
 
• It participated in the Imphal Campaign of 1944.
 
• Following the death of Subhash Chandra Bose in 1945, the unit was disbanded.
